## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

Parallel `tk test` runs in several checkouts start at most one server, thanks to a lock in the cache dir (spec §6).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concurrent `tk test` runs from two checkouts leave exactly one bazel-remote running
- [ ] Both runs use it

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.7
title: Only one test result cache server per machine
